entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Party
 Mr.M.K. Mohanty, Asc
 Coram:
 Justice Chittaranjan Dash
 Order
Order No. 15.05.2024
01. 1.

Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and the State.
2. This is an application for bail U/s.438 Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioners in apprehension of arrest for their alleged involvement in the offences U/s.417/493/376(3)/366/358/460/115 IPC read with Section 4(2) and 17 of the POCSO Act in connection with Bantala P.S. Case No.100 of 2024 corresponding to Special (P) Case No.13 of 2024 pending in the court of learned Addl.

. 
3. Learned counsel for the Petitioners submits that the Petitioners are the uncle and aunt of the principal accused.

4. Having regard to the allegations in the F.I.R., there appears material in the case with regard to the offence under the POCSO Act and as such it is not desirable for this Court to grant // 2 //
anticipatory bail without compliance of notice.

However, it is directed that in the event the Petitioners surrender and move for bail before the learned court below, the learned court in seisin over the matter shall dispose of the bail application on its own merit being alive of the position of law on bail keeping in view the gravity of the offences taking into consideration the materials on record as well as other documents available on record.
The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
